# SafeProof

Project page for SafeProof, a privacy-preserving harassment and abuse reporting protocol presented at the ACM womENcourage 2026 Hackathon. It combines OPRF-blinded target identifiers, salted evidence commitments, nullifier-based Sybil resistance, and threshold zero-knowledge proofs that reveal only how many distinct people reported one target.

Keywords: zero-knowledge proofs, nullifiers, Sybil resistance, oblivious PRF, harassment reporting, privacy, digital well-being
